key.name: last-camera-facing
key.summary: The facing last used: back, front or external

key.name: last-camera-id
key.summary: The libcamera id of the camera last used (empty: the main camera of last-camera-facing)

key.name: lens-labels
key.summary: Ordered lens bar labels by libcamera camera id

key.name: hidden-cameras
key.summary: Camera ids left out of the lens bar (the OV02B1B depth sensor is a mono 2 MP helper, not a lens)

key.name: tuning
key.summary: Gamma, contrast and saturation per camera id

key.name: last-camera-mode
key.summary: The mode last used: photo, video, qr or night

key.name: last-grid-mode
key.summary: The grid: off, 3x3, 4x4 or golden

key.name: last-mic-mode
key.summary: Record sound with videos (MIC ON)

key.name: photo-flash-mode
key.summary: The flash in photo mode: off, on (the torch for the shot) or torch

key.name: video-flash-mode
key.summary: The flash in video mode: off or torch

key.name: timer-mode
key.summary: The self-timer in seconds: 0, 3 or 10

key.name: aspect-ratio
key.summary: The photo aspect ratio: 4:3 or 16:9

key.name: video-quality
key.summary: The video size: 720p or 1080p (what the phone's encoder holds)

key.name: force-torch-help-shown
key.summary: The flash button's long press was explained (or used)

key.name: af-mode
key.summary: Autofocus: auto (focuses on its own and when the scene changes), tap (only when the viewfinder is tapped) or manual (the slider)

key.name: af-manual-position
key.summary: Manual focus: where the lens stands between af-pos-min and af-pos-max

key.name: af-pos-min
key.summary: The sweep starts at this lens position; the spring holds the lens at its stop under 384 (libcamera imx682.yaml scanMin)

key.name: af-pos-max
key.summary: The sweep ends at this lens position (clamped to what the lens reports)

key.name: af-coarse-steps
key.summary: Positions of the first sweep

key.name: af-refine-levels
key.summary: Each level measures the best position and half the previous distance either side of it

key.name: af-settle-ms
key.summary: After a lens move, frames are ignored for this long (libcamera shows the old position for about 150 ms and the coil needs up to 250 ms more)

key.name: af-skip-frames
key.summary: Frames ignored after that

key.name: af-roi
key.summary: Side of the measured square, a fraction of the frame short side

key.name: af-min-contrast
key.summary: Best over worst sharpness under this: no clear peak, the lens goes back to its last good position

key.name: af-min-score
key.summary: A best sharpness under this: nothing to focus on (a dark or blank scene)

key.name: af-min-luma
key.summary: A measured region whose mean grey (0 to 255) is under this is dark: its sharpness counts as 0

key.name: af-early-contrast
key.summary: The sweep stops at a peak this far over the worst score ...

key.name: af-early-drop
key.summary: ... once af-early-count scores in a row fell under this fraction of it

key.name: af-early-count
key.summary: Scores in a row that confirm the sweep went past the peak

key.name: af-plateau-tol
key.summary: Positions within this fraction of the peak are one plateau: its middle is taken

key.name: af-timeout-ms
key.summary: A search that takes longer fails

key.name: af-start-delay-ms
key.summary: After the first frame, before the first search (the exposure settles)

key.name: af-watch-every-ms
key.summary: Auto mode looks at the sharpness this often ...

key.name: af-watch-drop
key.summary: ... and searches again when it fell under this fraction of its reference ...

key.name: af-watch-count
key.summary: ... this many looks in a row ...

key.name: af-watch-gap-ms
key.summary: ... and not within this time of the last search

key.name: af-dt-root
key.summary: Where the kernel shows the devicetree (a sensor node names its lens in lens-focus)

key.name: af-subdev-class
key.summary: The V4L2 class directory, to find the lens subdev

key.name: af-dev-dir
key.summary: Where the subdev nodes are

key.name: bright-screen
key.summary: Bright screen: locks brightness to 100 %

key.name: save-location
key.summary: Save location data: unset (ask once), on or off

key.name: shutter-sound
key.summary: Play a sound on capture

key.name: leveler
key.summary: Show the leveler

key.name: volume-buttons-action
key.summary: The volume keys: shutter, focus, mic-mute, zoom, default or nothing

key.name: volume-buttons-invert
key.summary: Swap volume up and down (for zoom)

key.name: photo-ffc-mirror
key.summary: Save front camera photos as they appear in the preview

key.name: video-mirror-mode
key.summary: Mirror videos: off, on or front (front facing camera only)
